spapi.//inventory_ledger_days: Daily inventory-ledger window. Physical nexus depends on this feed, so the window is wider than strictly needed: Amazon can restate ledger rows for several days, and a wider window re-upserts them rather than missing them. Upsert-only — a narrow or wide window never deletes older events.
spapi.//inventory_ledger_backfill_days: Weekly deeper re-pull, for ledger rows Amazon settled after the daily window had moved on. Also upsert-only.
